description:
In this role, you will be at the forefront of launching and structuring the financial operations in a rapidly growing startup environment.   • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure proper tax reporting, filing, and payment processes.

What We Look for in the Ideal Candidate

  • Proven experience as a Finance Manager, Head of Finance, or similar role in a dynamic environment.
  • Strong understanding of cash flow management, bank reconciliation, and accounting principles.
  • Hands‑on experience with budgeting, forecasting, and risk management.
  • Proficiency in financial analysis, data modeling, and performance tracking.
  • Experience with financial software and reporting tools.
  • Excellent numerical, analytical, and problem‑solving skills.
  • Solid knowledge of corporate finance, compliance, and regulatory frameworks
  • Strong organizational and leadership abilities, with a hands‑on approach.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and communication skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Native Portuguese is required, along with fluency in English or Spanish, both spoken and written for effective communication in an international environment.

title: CX Designer SR (10111)
description:
A pessoa CX Designer será fundamental na otimização da jornada e experiência do cliente nos canais de comunicação automatizados, com foco em WhatsApp e Chatbot, do nosso parceiro da área de Seguros.

O grande desafio como CX Designer será realizar o entendimento aprofundado do fluxo de negócio e garantir a rastreabilidade e medição de toda a experiência por meio de tagueamento (instrumentação) de dados na jornada do cliente. Este profissional atuará como guardião da experiência, transformando dados em insights para desenhar fluxos mais eficientes, intuitivos e que gerem maior satisfação e conversão.

Nosso parceiro da área de Seguros busca constantemente aprimorar o design e a operação dos sistemas para garantir que sejam mais escaláveis, confiáveis e eficientes. Então, o papel da pessoa CX Designer é bastante estratégico para o negócio.

Para que a estratégia seja assertiva, a pessoa CX Designer fará parte de uma equipe ágil composta por Desenvolvedores, Líderes Técnicos, Analistas de QA, Analistas Funcionais, Product Owners (PO) e Scrum Masters.

Garantir a Rastreabilidade da Jornada: O desafio central é desenhar e documentar detalhadamente o tagueamento (instrumentação de dados) em cada ponto de interação da jornada (WhatsApp/Chatbot), garantindo que todos os eventos e gargalos do cliente sejam corretamente identificados e mensurados para análise de dados e Business Intelligence.

Otimização Contínua do Fluxo: Identificar e reprojetar os pontos de fricção (pain points), drop-offs e repetição de ciclos na jornada, transformando interações complexas em experiências fluidas e de baixo esforço.

Equilibrar Automação e Experiência Humana: Desenhar flows que maximizem a resolução de problemas por automação, mas que garantam uma transição suave e eficiente para o atendimento humano quando necessário, mantendo a voz e a personalidade da marca.

Tradução de Requisitos de Negócio em UX Funcional: Converter objetivos de negócio complexos em arquiteturas conversacionais e fluxos de usuário simples e compreensíveis.

Requisitos

  • Empatia e Customer Centricity: Capacidade genuína de se colocar no lugar do usuário para identificar pontos de dor e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Comunicação e Relacionamento Interpessoal: Clareza para articular insights, defender propostas de design e interagir com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.
  • Negociação e Persuasão: Habilidade para influenciar o roadmap do produto e negociar soluções de design que equilibrem a experiência do cliente com os objetivos de negócio e as restrições técnicas.
  • Resiliência e Adaptabilidade: Capacidade de navegar em ambientes dinâmicos e lidar com feedbacks e iterações rápidas, mantendo o foco na melhoria contínua.
  • Organização e Gestão de Fluxo: Proficiência em documentar, organizar e gerenciar a complexidade de fluxos de conversação e jornadas do usuário.
  • Liderança e Proatividade: Iniciativa para conduzir pesquisas, propor soluções e atuar como líder de pensamento em UX dentro da equipe.

Requisitos técnicos (hard skills)

  • Experiência Comprovada em Design Conversacional (Conversational UX/CUX): Sólida experiência no design de chatbots, URA e jornadas no WhatsApp, incluindo a criação de flows (fluxos), scripts e personas conversacionais.
  • Mapeamento de Jornada e Fluxos: Domínio em ferramentas e metodologias para mapear jornadas do usuário, blueprints de serviço e diagramas de fluxo de alta complexidade.
  • Tagueamento e Instrumentação de Dados (Analytics): Experiência em definir a estratégia e os requisitos de tagueamento (instrumentação) para mensuração de métricas de UX e negócio (ex: Drop-off Rate, Taxa de Sucesso, CSAT conversacional).
  • Prototipação e Testes: Proficiência em ferramentas de prototipação (Figma, Miro ou similar) e experiência na condução de testes de usabilidade, A/B testing e análise heurística em canais conversacionais.
  • Conhecimento de Plataformas de Chatbot/WhatsApp: Familiaridade com as limitações e capacidades de plataformas populares de construção de chatbots e APIs de WhatsApp Business.
  • UX Research: Capacidade de conduzir pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas para fundamentar decisões de design (entrevistas, análise de logs de conversação, pesquisa de satisfação).
  • Conceitos Ágeis: Experiência de trabalho em squads ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e colaboração estreita com Product Owners (PO) e engenheiros.

Do you want to work on the largest healthcare platform in the WORLD ?

We are Doctoralia, a Docplanner Group company, present in 13 countries, responsible for serving more than 55 million patients and processing more than 15 million appointments per month!

We currently have more than 2 million healthcare professionals in our database, totaling approximately 10 million patient evaluations to date.

Our mission is to “help people live longer, healthier lives.”

Through a diverse range of services, we serve different audiences: our marketplace, which allows patients to schedule and evaluate appointments and doctors at any time of the day or night; and our SaaS system (Software as a Service) aimed at optimizing office management, patient flow and online bookings. All this through an internet platform and our iOS/Android apps.

Here at DOC, we value and celebrate diversity in all its forms. We are committed to attracting diverse talent regardless of gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, age or physical condition. We are committed to building an inclusive and welcoming team where each individual can excel and contribute their best.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly analytical and execution-driven Revenue Operations Manager to lead our revenue operations strategy for the Individual Doctors segment (B2C2B). This role will oversee the entire revenue lifecycle across Marketing Ops, Sales Ops, and Customer Success Ops, ensuring alignment, efficiency, and growth across each stage of the customer journey.

As part of Doctoralia, the leading digital healthcare platform in Brazil and part of the Docplanner Group, you will play a key role in unlocking scalable growth by enabling data-driven decisions, optimizing operational processes, and ensuring seamless execution across go-to-market functions.

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end revenue operations strategy for the Individual Doctors segment;
  • Partner with Marketing, Sales, and CS leadership to design, execute, and optimize lead-to-revenue processes;
  • Build and maintain dashboards, KPIs, and forecasting tools to track funnel performance, conversion rates, and growth drivers;
  • Lead systems and tooling enhancements (CRM, marketing automation, customer platforms) to enable scalability and visibility;
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and lead cross-functional initiatives to solve them;
  • Create lead scoring, routing, and segmentation logic to improve acquisition efficiency;
  • Design playbooks and workflows to drive adoption and retention across the funnel;
  • Ensure governance, data hygiene, and operational rigor across revenue platforms;

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Economics, or similar (MBA is a plus);
  • Solid experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Growth Operations roles;
  • Experience managing cross-functional revenue funnels (Marketing → Sales → CS);
  • Proficiency in CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, or Pipedrive), BI tools (Looker, Tableau), and Excel/Google Sheets;
  • Strong analytical and modeling skills (SQL or data querying is a plus);
  • Fluency in Portuguese; business English required.

Key Competencies

  • Analytical Thinking: Able to interpret data to inform strategy and drive decisions;
  • Revenue Orientation: Understands the full funnel impact of operations on growth;
  • Process Optimization: Passion for reducing inefficiencies and building scalable systems;
  • Collaboration: Skilled at aligning cross-functional stakeholders and driving action;
  • Ownership Mentality: Bias toward execution and continuous improvement.

Our benefits

  • Working hours are from Monday to Friday, from 9 am to 6 pm;
  • We have compensatory time off (Banco de Horas);
  • Food/Market Voucher with iFood card;
  • Medical, Dental, and Group Life Insurance;
  • Pet Plan;
  • StarBem, for mental health and well-being;

  • Gympass for you and up to 3 people;
  • Creditas: Payroll loan services, eligible after 6 months of employment;
  • Stock Options – eligible after 6 months of employment (5 years grace period);
  • Birthday Day Off;
  • Daycare Assistance;
  • Partnership Club, with discounts ranging from teaching institutions, such as colleges and language learning services;
  • Referral Program offers up to R$600 per person who stays with us for more than 6 months;
  • Leave of Absence/Time-off: in the event of the passing of loved ones, we offer 10 days off; if your pet passes away, we offer 2 days. Got married? 7 days of rest! Did the baby arrive? We offer 30 days for Dads and 6 months for Moms.

At THE/STUDIO, our vision is to empower individuals, regardless of their expertise, to unleash their creativity and bring their unique ideas to life through the production of custom products. We are committed to delivering top-quality customized products that not only exceed expectations but also provide a seamless and awe‑inspiring experience via our exceptional team and AI‑integrated systems. Our headquarters are in Los Angeles, California, but we are a truly global company with team‑members across the U.S., Europe, South America, Africa, and Asia/Pacific. We have gone to a fully remote working platform so that we can attract the world’s best talent.

All roles at THE/STUDIO are 100% remote from anywhere in the world, as long as you have all your tools and a fast, stable internet connection!

The Role

At THE/STUDIO, we help creators and brands bring their product ideas to life: from custom hats to packaging. Our Creative Specialists are trusted advisors to our customers: they don’t just close deals, they build long-term partnerships that fuel repeat business.

We’re looking for experienced sales professionals with a strong consultative sales foundation who can confidently manage inbound opportunities, uncover deeper customer needs, and nurture accounts over time. This role is ideal for someone who already knows how to sell, structure their day, and run a pipeline; and is excited to apply those skills in a fast‑paced, remote‑first startup environment.

As a Creative Specialist, you’ll own the full inbound sales cycle while developing repeat customers by helping them grow their own businesses through THE/STUDIO’s manufacturing solutions.

What You’ll Do

  • Consistently meet and exceed KPIs and revenue targets.
  • Identify opportunities to improve sales processes, tools, and workflows as we scale.

What Success Looks Like

  • Ramp quickly and gain a strong understanding of THE/STUDIO’s value proposition and product offering.
  • Become proficient with inbound email sequencing, fast sales cadences, and CRM workflows.
  • Begin laying the groundwork for future repeat business through thoughtful follow‑ups and account notes.

Within 3 Months

  • Master how to identify, build, and nurture repeat customers with well‑defined follow‑up cadences.
  • Run a fully self‑driven, structured day‑to‑day sales workflow.
  • Proactively advise customers on how they can grow their own businesses using THE/STUDIO.
  • Demonstrate excellent CRM hygiene and clear account ownership.
  • Be recognized by teammates as someone who raises the bar and improves team productivity.

Within 6 Months

  • Own a healthy book of repeat customers who consistently come back to work with you.
  • Continuously exceed your quota and build a strong forward‑looking pipeline.
  • Identify and implement tools, methods, or sales processes that improve performance.
  • Be on track for increased responsibility and future promotion opportunities.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3–5 years of recent, quota‑carrying sales experience (not historic).

  • Experience selling products or solutions in high‑velocity, SMB, or service‑based environments.

  • Coachable, curious, resilient, and comfortable receiving direct feedback.

  • Experience collaborating with design teams; Adobe Illustrator knowledge is an advantage.

Why You’ll Love It Here

Additional Attributes & Process

  • Intellectually curious – possesses a natural disposition and comfort to ask questions, challenge the status quo, and a desire to ‘get to the bottom of things’ if they see something not quite right
  • Self‑motivated with a meaningful reason to deliver excellence

Turing is one of the world’s fastest‑growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real‑world AI systems that solve mission‑critical priorities for companies.

Role Overview

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! Your role is critical in helping fine‑tune and improve large language models (like GPT), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future‑prove your career in an AI‑first world!

What does day‑to‑day look like

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day?

Requirements

  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self‑motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor’s degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in data interpretation, logical reasoning and basic arithmetic is highly desirable.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting‑edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)

About The Job

Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today\'s dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.

As the YouTube Ads Strategy Lead, you will serve as the primary architect for YouTube’s product and business generation strategy in Brazil. Sitting at the intersection of Product and Sales, you function as a Product Lead within a commercial structure, driving the long-term roadmap for how YouTube competes for and wins advertising budgets.

Your strategy will be rooted in a deep, holistic understanding of the platform’s ecosystem—starting from user consumption behavior to inform monetization frameworks. You will be the go-to expert on the Brazilian media landscape, leveraging deep knowledge from traditional TV to social platforms dynamics to position YouTube as the premier choice for advertisers. You will translate complex internal data into actionable business intelligence, crafting the narratives that drive video products adoption and revenue growth.

Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.

Responsibilities

  • Centralize YouTube’s business generation strategy in Brazil, acting as the bridge between local sales and global teams.

  • Co-lead the annual plan, prioritizing and communicating Brazil’s business requirements to global product and engineering stakeholders.

The Supply Chain Analyst will play a key role in developing and managing Latitude.sh’s capacity planning and vendor analysis framework across global data center operations — including space, power, network, and servers. Working closely with Procurement, Operations, and Finance teams, the analyst will anticipate capacity requirements, evaluate vendor proposals, and deliver clear reporting that guides infrastructure and procurement strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Capacity Planning & Forecasting
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive capacity planning models for data center space, power, servers, and network resources such as IP transit and backbone connectivity.
  • Forecast utilization to identify where capacity constraints may occur across the global portfolio.
  • Track provisioned versus active usage and provide early visibility into expansion needs.
  • Maintain dashboards showing available capacity, forecasted growth, and expected exhaustion timelines by site and service type.
  • Vendor Evaluation & Cost Analysis
  • Analyze and compare vendor proposals and quotes for data center colocation, IP transit, backbone, and related network services.
  • Build standardized cost‑comparison models to identify the most cost‑efficient vendor options.
  • Support procurement decisions with clear, data‑driven recommendations and total cost analyses.
  • Monitor vendor pricing, terms, and performance to ensure competitiveness and long‑term value.
  • Operational Reporting & Insights
  • Develop and manage a monthly reporting package or dashboard showing month‑over‑month and year‑over‑year variances in data center and network costs, and aggregate breakdowns by region, vendor, and service category.
  • Compare committed capacity versus billed actuals to identify underutilized or overextended resources and ensure full use of contracted commitments.
  • Validate and reconcile data across Finance and Operations to ensure reporting accuracy.
  • Present insights and recommendations that inform vendor selection, cost optimization, and capacity planning across teams.

Skills And Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Finance, Engineering, Economics, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and work experience).
  • 2+ years of experience in supply chain analysis, capacity planning, cost management, or financial analysis, ideally within technology, telecommunications, or data center environments.
  • Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, scenario modeling).
  • Experience using data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker Studio.
  • Fluent in Portuguese, with professional‑level English (written and spoken).
  • Background in data center operations, network procurement, or telecom cost modeling (IP transit, dark fiber, backbone).

Preferred

  • Familiarity with ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle) and SQL or other data tools.
  • Exposure to DCIM, NetBox, or other infrastructure inventory systems.
  • Highly analytical and detail‑oriented, with strong quantitative reasoning.
  • Organized and methodical, capable of structuring complex datasets into clear insights.
  • Proactive and forward‑looking, anticipating capacity and cost challenges.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, effective with both technical and business audiences.
  • Collaborative and dependable, thriving in a dynamic, global environment.

What do we offer?

description:
Full Stack Developer for Cloud based Applications

Join to apply for the Full Stack Developer for Cloud based Applications role at TK Elevator

Are you ready to shape the future of vertical transportation by building the digital solutions that power innovation? At TK Elevator, a globally leading elevator and escalator company, we're revolutionizing how people experience buildings through digital solutions that integrate elevator systems, embedded technology, cloud platforms, and AI-powered experiences.

Responsibilities

As full stack Application Developer, you'll bring a hands‑on, pragmatic get‑things‑done attitude to designing, developing, and maintaining digital service applications that bridge the physical and digital worlds. You'll roll up your sleeves to work closely with cross‑functional teams—UX/UI designers, product owners, and fellow developers—to deliver scalable, secure, and user‑friendly solutions that make our customers successful and transform service efficiency for 20,000+ technicians worldwide.

  • Application Development & Architecture: Design, implement, and maintain modern web and mobile applications using frameworks like Angular, .NET, and MAUI. Build cloud‑native solutions that are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with microservices, event‑driven architectures, and API‑first design principles.
  • Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Work closely with UX/UI designers, product owners, architects, and other development teams to translate business requirements into elegant technical solutions. Contribute to architectural decisions and share knowledge across the global team.
  • Code Excellence & Best Practices: Write clean, maintainable, and well‑documented code that others can understand and build upon. Participate actively in code reviews, champion best practices, and continuously improve code quality and development standards.
  • DevOps & Quality Integration: Develop automated tests and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines to ensure reliable and efficient deployment. Support continuous integration and delivery practices that enable rapid, safe releases to production.
  • Performance & Reliability: Troubleshoot issues proactively, optimise application performance, and provide ongoing support for existing applications. Monitor system health and respond to incidents when needed to ensure high availability.
  • Security‑First Mindset: Integrate cybersecurity best practices into all phases of the development lifecycle. Implement secure authentication/authorization, protect sensitive data, and stay current with security vulnerabilities and mitigation strategies.

Qualifications

  • Development Experience & Expertise: 5+ years of hands‑on experience in application development with a proven track record building cloud‑native applications. Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and C# with deep experience in modern frameworks including Angular, .NET, and MAUI.
  • Cloud & Architecture Proficiency: Hands‑on experience with cloud platforms, particularly Azure, and solid understanding of microservices architectures, event‑driven systems, and API‑first design. Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and asynchronous messaging systems (Kafka, MQTT).
  • DevOps & Modern Development Practices: Strong understanding of DevOps practices and tools including Git, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines. Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools like Grafana and OpenTelemetry. Experience with infrastructure as code and containerisation is a plus.
  • Security & Compliance Knowledge: Understanding of secure software design principles, authentication/authorization mechanisms (OAuth2, OpenID Connect), and data protection requirements. Experience implementing security best practices in application development.
  • Agile & Team Collaboration: Proven experience working in agile, cross‑functional product teams with ability to collaborate effectively across disciplines and time zones. Comfortable in a fast‑paced, iterative development environment.
  • Educational Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Personal Attributes

  • Problem‑solver: Strong analytical skills with ability to break down complex requirements into elegant solutions.
  • Pragmatic & hands‑on: Strongly driven, get‑things‑done attitude—ready to roll up your sleeves and go the extra mile to make products successful.
  • Team player & independent: Collaborative team member who can also take ownership and work independently when needed.
  • Clear communicator: Good communication skills in English, able to explain technical concepts to both technical and non‑technical audiences.
  • Quality‑focused: Takes pride in writing clean code and building solutions that users love.

Benefits

Health care, Dental care, Bonus, Private pension, Program for pregnant women, Social support program, Life insurance, Telemedicine, Telenutrition, Telepsychology, Restaurant, Transportation.

Company

People are at the heart of everything we do at TK Elevator: we work as a team, care about each other’s safety and share a common vision to keep the world moving. This is your opportunity to go further and impact the future of urban mobility.

Creative PR Manager, Global Communications

Responsibilities

About the Team
TikTok’s Global Communications team is charged with telling the company's story and protecting the public trust that is fundamental to TikTok’s success. The team works across all business functions and regions to clearly articulate what TikTok is, what it stands for, and how it operates. Through clear, authentic, and purposeful storytelling, Global Comms engages the many audiences that interact with the platform, including global media, policymakers, key opinion leaders, professional creators, communities, and businesses of all sizes. Joining Global Communications offers a rare opportunity to operate at the intersection of technology and culture, shaping global conversations around the world.

About the Role
TikTok’s Global Communications team is looking for a strategic, hands‑on Creative PR Manager to join our Latin America team, based in Brazil. This role sits at the intersection of culture, technology, and reputation, playing a key part in shaping TikTok’s public narrative across the region.

If you thrive in fast‑paced environments, think big while executing with precision, and love building stories that travel across culture, media, and business, this role is for you.

  • Lead proactive, culturally relevant communication strategies that connect creators, SMBs, and audiences to the TikTok brand.
  • Act as a strategic partner to Operations, Marketing, Social, and Public Policy teams, bringing bold ideas that challenge the status quo.
  • Build strong relationships with media, key opinion leaders, and creator communities to generate distinctive, earned cultural moments.
  • Drive reputation management efforts across Latin America through innovative, insight‑driven PR strategies.
  • Translate complex policy, safety, and business topics into clear, compelling narratives for external audiences.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in communications, PR, or marketing (entertainment, tech, or related industries preferred).
  • Full professional proficiency in Portuguese and English (English is required for daily collaboration with global partners).
  • Proven experience working cross‑functionally with Marketing, Social, and Creator teams to deliver integrated communication strategies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Track record of leading creative, differentiated campaigns in competitive markets.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Ability to thrive in fast‑paced, high‑growth environments.
  • Passion for storytelling and media relations across Latin America.

About ByteDance Brazil

ByteDance is a global incubator of platforms at the cutting edge of commerce, content, entertainment, and enterprise services - over 2.5 billion people interact with ByteDance products, including TikTok.

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok’s mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We’re resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an “Always Day 1” mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

TikTok Accommodation

TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at

title: *Banco de talentos - Diversidade e Inclusão na Nextar
description:
Que coisa boa seu interesse em fazer parte do nosso time!

Na Nextar, sabemos que uma equipe diversa é a chave para a inovação e para criar soluções que realmente transformem a vida das pessoas a frente do comércio. O respeito às diferenças é um dos nossos valores culturais.

Por isso, criamos este Banco de Talentos de Diversidade e Inclusão : um canal exclusivo e prioritário para conhecer profissionais incríveis que se autodeclaram como parte de qualquer grupo diverso (seja por raça/etnia, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, pessoa com deficiência, 50+, ou outros).

O objetivo é simples: queremos conhecer você agora , mesmo que a vaga dos seus sonhos ainda não esteja aberta.

Como funciona o Banco de Talentos?

  1. Inscrição: Você preenche nosso formulário de inscrição (são 13 perguntas rápidas) e nos conta sobre suas habilidades, experiências e áreas de interesse.

  2. Análise: Nossa equipe de Recrutamento & Seleção irá analisar seu perfil com carinho e adicioná-lo ao nosso banco interno, organizado por áreas de talento.

  3. Prioridade: Assim que uma nova oportunidade alinhada ao seu perfil surgir, você será uma das primeiras pessoas a saber! Entraremos em contato assim que abrirmos a vaga para o público geral, usando o local que você indicou no questionário.

Um pouco sobre a Nextar:

Somos pessoas apaixonadas pelo comércio! A Nextar atua desde 2003 criando soluções que transformem o comércio em uma atividade simples, justa e economicamente viável. Acreditamos nas pessoas e no empreendedorismo e nos dedicamos todos os dias para sermos facilitadores da rotina do pequeno comércio. Por isso, trabalhamos para desenvolver e entregar produtos e serviços de qualidade para mais de 50 mil pequenos comércios no Brasil e no mundo!

O que buscamos nas pessoas para compor nossa equipe?

Comprometimento e prazer em trabalhar colaborativamente — que busque facilitar a vida das pessoas, tanto colegas, quanto clientes e empenhe-se em manter o ambiente amigável.

We are looking for a Product Manager to lead the Search product within the BEES app. Search is a critical capability for BEES, powering most product findability flows and directly impacting GMV across multiple markets.

This role sits within the BEES Core team, responsible for building scalable, reliable, and reusable capabilities that serve multiple BEES platforms (Customer, Force, and Link).

You will work closely with engineering, data, design, and multiple product teams to evolve our search algorithms, infrastructure, and user experience, ensuring high performance, reliability, and relevance at scale.

  • Collaborate with global stakeholders, presenting updates and insights to senior leadership.

What you'll need:

  • Experience working with data to analyze product performance, identify issues, and support decision-making;
  • Experience working in cross-functional and highly collaborative environments;
  • Familiarity with Agile product development practices;
  • Advanced English skills (written and spoken), with the ability to present and communicate with global stakeholders.

Nice to have

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

title: FISIOTERAPEUTA - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description:
Descrição da vaga

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Realizar diagnóstico e prognóstico fisioterapêutico e tratamento dos distúrbios cinéticos funcionais de ordem neurológica, motora ou respiratória, visando o restabelecimento parcial ou completo da função.

Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino Superior Completo em Fisioterapia;

Especialização completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Neonatologia, Pediatria, Saúde da Criança e do Adolescente, Terapia Intensiva, Neurofuncional, Traumato Ortopedia ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde;

Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;

Experiência mínima de 06 meses comprovada na função de Fisioterapeuta.

Escala: 12 horas de trabalho X 60 horas de descanso

Horário: 19:00 às 07:00 / 07:00 às 19:00

description:
Descrição da vaga

Educar é um ato de responsabilidade moral e social. Junte-se a nós nesta jornada transformadora!

Em 2023, nasceu a APG GOV, que tem como missão transformar lives na Rede Pública Brasileira - a partir de um sonho audacioso: aplicar um modelo de gestão que apoiasse o diretor pedagógico e alavancar a inovação - junto a um compromisso profundo com o desenvolvimento individual e coletivo.

CONHEÇA NOSSA HISTÓRIA

A Rede de Ensino APOGEU foi fundada no ano 2000, por três jovens empreendedores e ex-alunos do Instituto Tecnológico da Aeronáutica (ITA).

Ao longo do tempo, a instituição vem realizando, com êxito, o seu propósito: já são mais de 4.600 aprovações históricas em universidades públicas de todo o país.

E, em 2023, nasceu a APG GOV: que tem como missão transformar lives na Rede Pública Brasileira – a partir de um sonho audacioso: aplicar um modelo de gestão que apoiasse o diretor pedagógico e alavancar a inovação – junto a um compromisso profundo com o desenvolvimento individual e coletivo.

Estamos dedicados a proporcionar uma operação excepcional que prepara os alunos não apenas para sucesso acadêmico, mas também para uma vida de contribuição significativa para a sociedade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

A Nutricionista é responsável pelo monitoramento técnico nutricional nas instituições de ensino, tendo como foco a oferta diária de alimentos saudáveis, adequados e seguros, do ponto de vista higiênico sanitário, resultando em menor desperdício e atendendo às necessidades nutricionais dos escolares durante o período letivo, de forma a contribuir para o crescimento e o desenvolvimento biopsicossocial, aprendizagem, rendimento escolar e formação de práticas alimentares saudáveis.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Utilizar ferramentas e mecanismos de monitoramento técnico nutricional na instituição de ensino, tendo como foco a oferta diária de alimentos saudáveis, adequados e seguros, do ponto de vista higiênico sanitário, resultando em menor desperdício e atendendo às necessidades nutricionais dos escolares durante o período letivo, de forma a contribuir para o crescimento e o desenvolvimento biopsicossocial, aprendizagem, rendimento escolar e formação de práticas alimentares saudáveis;
  • Observar as normativas federais do Programa Nacional de Alimentação Escolar - PNAE, as instruções normativas vigentes do Instituto Fundepar e do Conselho Federal de Nutricionista;
  • Atender ao Descrito no ANEXO I.I Alimentação Escolar do Edital de Chamamento Público SEED/PR Nº 17/2024.

Requisitos e qualificações

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Formação acadêmica completa em Nutrição;
  • Inscrita e regularizada junto ao Conselho Regional de Nutricionistas da 8ª Região.

DIFERENCIAIS

  • Planejamento de Compras e Gestão Orçamentária – Capacidade de calcular a demanda de alimentos e administrar o orçamento público ou escolar de forma eficiente;
  • Gestão de Estoque e Controle de Qualidade – Experiência no controle de insumos, monitoramento de validade dos alimentos, armazenamento adequado e redução de desperdícios;
  • Habilidade de Comunicação – Facilidade para interagir com a equipe da cozinha, gestores escolares, estudantes e responsáveis, garantindo alinhamento e efetividade na execução das ações nutricionais;
  • Compromisso com a Educação Alimentar – Atuação ativa na conscientização da comunidade escolar sobre a importância de uma alimentação saudável e equilibrada;
  • Conhecimento básico em informática – especialmente para preenchimento de relatórios e acompanhamento de sistemas de gestão.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Você atuará em um cliente do segmento do agronegócio , referência em inovação e transformação digital, com foco na modernização de processos, automação de fluxos e uso estratégico de tecnologia para ganho de eficiência operacional e apoio à tomada de decisão.

  • Desenvolver e implementar fluxos de automação de software , utilizando Inteligência Artificial como ferramenta de apoio ao desenvolvimento, validação e testes.
  • Criar e manter testes de automação , inclusive com suporte de ferramentas baseadas em LLMs.

  • Aplicar engenharia de prompt e contexto para integrar funcionalidades baseadas em IA a sistemas já existentes.

  • Apoiar a definição de requisitos técnicos e padrões de arquitetura das soluções.
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com times técnicos e áreas de negócio em ambiente ágil.

O que você precisa ter

  • Vivência com NodeJS para integração e suporte às automações.
  • Experiência no consumo e desenvolvimento de APIs REST .
  • Experiência em análise funcional , entendimento de processos e desenho de fluxos.
  • Conhecimento aplicado em engenharia de prompt para LLMs .
  • Experiência com testes automatizados .
  • Atuação em ambientes ágeis (Scrum / Kanban).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento de código (Git ).

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

title: Creative Strategist (DTC E-Commerce)
description:
Creative Strategist (DTC E-Commerce)

Location: Remote

Working Hours: Monday to Friday, minimum 4 hours overlap with UK GMT

Contract Type: Independent contractor

You write ads that sell. You can watch a winning VSL and break down exactly why it works. You read ad comments sections for fun. You've written scripts that stopped thumbs, moved product, and hit CPA targets, and you can prove it.

If that sounds like you, keep reading.

About Purolabs

Purolabs is an independent, family-run DTC supplements brand based in South London. We have served over 350,000 customers with clean, science-backed supplements. No fillers, no additives, no nonsense. Featured in Vogue, Women’s Health, and Evening Standard, we are a profitable, fast-growing brand proving that natural wellness can be both effective and transparent.

No shareholders to impress. No cutting corners. Just a genuine mission to help people feel better.

The Role

Creative strategy is our biggest growth lever. We are hiring a Creative Strategist to own the full creative system for our paid advertising, from research and ideation through to briefing, production, and performance analysis. You will develop ad concepts, write scripts and copy, create briefs, and work with editors and creators to produce ads that convert at scale.

This is a performance role. Data guides everything. You will live inside our ad accounts, study what’s working, and use those insights to develop the next round of winning creatives. Creative instinct matters, but the numbers have the final say.

Beyond individual ad creation, you will build and refine the system itself: creative roadmaps, testing cadence, playbooks, feedback loops, and production workflows. The goal is a repeatable engine, not a series of one-offs.

Your primary focus is Meta (Facebook/Instagram). Experience with TikTok or YouTube advertising is a bonus.

What You’ll Do

Research & Insight

  • Mine customer reviews, surveys, forums, and ad comments to understand the language, pain points, and motivations of our audience
  • Monitor competitor ads, offers, angles, and landing pages across the DTC landscape
  • Turn research into clear hypotheses and test plans grounded in consumer psychology

Creative Development

  • Develop ad concepts, hooks, angles, and scripts for video ads, VSLs, and UGC content
  • Write direct-response copy for static ads, carousels, and advertorials
  • Create detailed creative briefs for designers, video editors, and UGC creators
  • Own landing page strategy and messaging for paid campaigns, working with the team to build high-converting pages
  • Build and maintain a library of proven hooks, frameworks, and winning ad structures

Performance & Iteration

  • Analyse ad account data to identify winning patterns, fatiguing creatives, and new opportunities
  • Iterate on winning ads at scale, producing variations of hooks, body copy, CTAs, and visual treatments
  • Run a tight feedback loop: learn from data, iterate on what works, kill what doesn’t
  • Present weekly creative performance reports with clear recommendations for what to test next

Process & Production

  • Maintain a strong creative cadence: roadmap, launch schedule, timelines, and quality control
  • Manage creative production flow, approvals, and external vendors
  • Build and refine playbooks, workflows, and processes to improve creative output over time
  • Collaborate with our Performance Marketing Manager, designers, video editors, and UGC creators

What We’re Looking For

Essential

  • 3+ years of experience in direct-response creative strategy for DTC e-commerce (brand-side, agency, or freelance)
  • Proven track record writing ad scripts, VSL scripts, and static ad copy that delivered measurable results
  • Strong understanding of direct-response copywriting principles (AIDA, PAS, and similar frameworks)
  • Deep knowledge of Meta Ads platform and experience working in high-volume creative testing environments
  • Experience creating detailed creative briefs and managing creative production workflows
  • Strong understanding of consumer psychology, buyer motivation, and what makes people click
  • Ability to analyse ad performance data and translate insights into actionable creative direction
  • Experience using AI tools like Claude and Gemini
  • Excellent written English, clear and persuasive

Nice to Have

  • Experience in health, wellness, supplements, or beauty DTC brands
  • TikTok or YouTube advertising experience
  • Experience casting and managing UGC creators
  • Familiarity with tools like Foreplay, Motion, Triple Whale, or Meta Ad Library
  • Landing page copywriting or CRO experience
  • Basic video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere, or similar)
  • Basic design skills (Figma or Canva) for static ad concepts

You’ll Thrive Here If You Are

  • Data-obsessed. You make creative decisions based on evidence, not gut feeling. You would rather test than argue.
  • Commercially minded. You care about ROAS and CPA, not just aesthetics. A beautiful ad that does not convert is a failed ad.
  • Fast-moving. You can produce and iterate at pace without sacrificing quality. Speed and volume matter in creative testing.
  • Proactive. You do not wait to be told what to test next. You bring ideas to the table constantly.
  • Detail-oriented. Your briefs are clear. Your scripts are tight. You spot what others miss.
  • A student of the game. You are constantly saving ads, studying hooks, and analysing what’s working across DTC.

What Success Looks Like (First 6 Months)

  • Creative strategy is fully owned and running as a consistent, repeatable system
  • You have deep customer understanding and clear positioning across the funnel
  • You have made measurable impact on ad performance through stronger creative strategy and faster iteration
  • Creative roadmap, playbooks, and production workflows are documented and running smoothly

What We Offer

  • Fully remote, work from anywhere with at least 4 hours daily overlap with UK timezone
  • Competitive rate based on experience
  • Paid time off including UK bank holidays
  • Creative freedom to test bold ideas and own your work from concept to results
  • Direct collaboration with founders, no layers of management
  • A small, dedicated team that values transparency, results, and doing things the right way
  • Products that genuinely help people feel better

How to Apply

Your application must include:

  1. Your CV in English
  2. A portfolio of ad creative work. Show us ads you have written or developed, with context on the results they drove. This can be a PDF, website, Google Drive link, or Notion page. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.
  3. A short Vocaroo recording (2-3 minutes) introducing yourself, what you have worked on, and why this role interests you. Applications without a Vocaroo will not be considered.

This is a remote independent contractor role, not employment. Applications are welcome globally.

title: HSS and Signalling Engineer - São Paulo/Rio de Janeiro Based
description:
About Us

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider, delivering global connectivity solutions to enterprises and consumers. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform – including its own owned and operated global mobile core network, fully fledged in-house developed eSIM technology, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses – 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide.

We serve many of the world’s leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, global fast moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally , enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues in 2025 exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million , we generate strong cash flows to fund our growth allowing us to continuously invest in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass-consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose-built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own aspirations to offer telecommunications services to their clients.

Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs, Hakan KoçandPyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications . We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.

About the Team

As a Network Engineering member, in the Signalling functional area, you will be responsible for proposing, analysing and defining the requirements for new and existing services and systems, related with the signalling routing area and subscriber data management systems under the responsibility of the functional area. Prepare, design, test and provide new solutions or product changes of the already existing portfolio. Define and support the technology evolution roadmap for the systems under the functional area. Participate and support the other functional areas in cross functional projects.

About the Role

  • Collaboration with other Networks teams in defining and managing the projects for delivery of new solutions
  • Project delivery. Network design. Integration and migration strategy definition. Collaboration with other relevant departments. Responsible for end-to-end delivery
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Creation of technical documentation (HLD’s, LLD’s, WO’s, etc.) and maintain it over the lifecycle of the solutions
  • Perform implementations in live environment. Understanding of End to End system testing requirements
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators
  • Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition
  • Service & Resource configuration definition and implementation on requested systems
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and addresses design issues for future products or technologies
  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers
  • Elaborate, and manage the process, for change requests to current partners in order to meet the network necessities
  • Control the network elements roadmap, being responsible for the necessary software/hardware upgrade during the components lifecycle
  • Generate and implement process improvements, including and especially cross-team processes
  • Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and/or alternatives.

About You

Must-haves

  • Proven experience on implementation of live solutions on mobile telecom (GSM, UMTS, LTE, IMS), networks design, capacity management, engineering and architecture
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, GSMA, ITU standards and specifications
  • Experience in the design, test and operation of signalling network functions, including STPs, DEA/DRAs and HLR/HSS
  • Experience in defining, establishing and maintaining signalling interconnects, SIGTRAN and DIAMETER based, using SCTP multi-homing
  • Experience with HLR/HSS, subscriber profiles, subscriber repositories and respective reference interfaces
  • Knowledge of IMS Architecture with understanding of IMS nodes, including Application Servers and its interaction with profile repositories
  • Experience in mobile services charging (online). Knowledge and experience Ro, Gy, Gx interfaces
  • Knowledge and experience with signalling protocols and routing including M3UA, M2PA, DIAMETER, as we well as upper layer protocols such as MAP, CAMEL, Sh, Cx
  • Knowledge of 5G SA networks, from a signalling (SCP and SEPP) and AUSF/UDM/UDR perspective
  • Experience with protocol analyser tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot networks errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice-to-haves

  • +3 years working on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks
  • Previous experience with Nokia, Oracle, HPE products

What We Offer?

  • CLT contract —enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card —R$100per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica —50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave - 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave.
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old —R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)!

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real‑world expertise from across the globe.

Who We're Looking For

We are seeking curious and intellectually proactive contributors who double‑check assumptions and play devil’s advocate, comfortable with ambiguity and complexity. This flexible, project‑based opportunity is ideal for analysts, researchers, experienced professionals and consultants with strong critical‑thinking skills, and for those open to a part‑time, non‑permanent role.

About the Project

You will create complex, realistic tasks that push frontier AI agents to their limits. Think scattered data, conditional procedures, and genuine domain expertise. You’ll build a detailed version with objective scoring, then write an ambiguous version to train the agent to succeed with less hand‑holding. Real expert complexity only – you’re improving the AI tools you’ll eventually use yourself.

If you have the relevant experience and are ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, join us!

How to Get Started

Apply to this post to contribute to projects aligned with your skills on your own schedule. To begin working in production, you’ll need to complete a qualification step and project onboarding, where you’ll become familiar with the guidelines interface and try your first real task with guidance from our quality team. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you’ll directly shape how useful these models become for your future work.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Accounting, Auditing, Financial Accounting, or closely aligned areas
  • Professional industry experience in accounting with a minimum of three years in relevant fields (e.g., audit, financial reporting, internal controls, tax, management accounting). Experience in cross‑functional, applied, or international projects is an advantage.
  • Having a chartered accountancy qualification such as CPA, ACCA, or ICAEW is an advantage
  • Familiarity with U.S. GAAP standards
  • Ability to write clearly and professionally, including explaining complex tasks in simple, structured language
  • Ability to analyze and synthesize information from multiple sources and turn it into accurate, coherent outputs
  • Creativity in designing realistic and engaging examples, cases, or workflows based on your domain knowledge
  • Proven ability to use English fluently in professional settings, written and verbal (C1/C2 level)
  • Access to a laptop, stable internet connection, and sufficient availability to engage with project tasks
  • Motivation to work with challenging, complex, but well‑defined guidelines, learn new methods, and strengthen domain‑specific skills

Benefits

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $16 hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs
  • Take part in a part‑time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise

Acidente na BR-267 mata passageiro e deixa motorista ferido

(Foto: Reprodução/ Rio Brilhante em Tempo Real)

Gol saiu da pista, capotou e parou em plantação; polícia investiga origem de produtos encontrados no veículo

Um grave acidente na BR-267, no km 336, entre Maracaju e Rio Brilhante, resultou na morte de um homem, de 41 anos, morador da Vila Industrial, em Dourados. A colisão aconteceu na noite de quarta-feira (19).

A vítima era passageira de um Volkswagen Gol que seguia no sentido Maracaju para Rio Brilhante quando o motorista perdeu o controle da direção. O veículo saiu da pista, capotou e só parou em uma plantação às margens da rodovia. Durante o capotamento, a vítima foi arremessada para fora do carro e morreu ainda no local.

O motorista, único sobrevivente, sofreu ferimentos e foi encaminhado ao hospital de Maracaju. Até o momento, não há atualização sobre o estado de saúde dele.

Durante a vistoria no automóvel, policiais encontraram pacotes de cigarros, essências de narguilé e frascos de perfume. A carga foi apreendida e deve passar por investigação para identificar a origem e a finalidade do material.

Equipes da Polícia Rodoviária Federal (PRF), Polícia Civil e perícia criminal estiveram no local para realizar os levantamentos e apurar as causas do acidente.

Descrição da vaga

Junta-se a nós e venha trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas especializadas em assistência à aviação no Brasil. ✈️

Globalmente, adnata foi fundada em 1959, em Dubai. Possuímos mais de 46.000 funcionários divididos em 38 países, nos 6 continentes, com atuação em 136 aeroportos e auxiliando mais de 347 clientes pelo mundo.

Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para oAeroporto de Brasilia (BSB)!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Possuímos várias posições disponíveis com foco operacional, as principais sendo:

  • Auxiliar de Rampa

As atividades consistem na movimentação de bagagens da esteira para equipamentos de transporte, calçamento, carregamento e descarregamento de aeronaves com malas e cargas, sinalização em torno do voo a ser atendido, inspeção e varredura do piso para coleta de objetos caídos. Dentre os equipamentos e mobiliários utilizados destacam-se telefone e rádio de comunicação. O setor encontra-se no subsolo, com acesso do colaborador ao posto de trabalho por elevadores e escadas rolantes e deslocamento pelas áreas operacionais do aeroporto.

Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura em bipedestação para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, rotação e flexão do tronco, esforço físico e deambulação por toda área operacional.

Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para movimentação de bagagens da esteira para equipamentos de transporte, calçamento, carregamento e descarregamento de aeronaves com malas e cargas, sinalização em torno do voo a ser atendido, inspeção e varredura do piso para coleta de objetos caídos, percepção auditiva para identificação de sinais sonoros de equipamentos e máquinas na pista.

Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

  • Auxiliar de Serviços Gerais (Limpeza)

As atividades consistem na organização da bolsa de suprimentos, aguardo da liberação de limpeza pela tripulação, acoplamento da escada na aeronave, coleta dos sacos de lixos, reposição dos suprimentos, aspiração do carpete, verificação da presença de objetos e higienização das poltronas e de bolsões, preenchimento de documentação do voo e limpeza das salas administrativas. Dentre os equipamentos utilizados destacam-se telefone, aspirador, panos, sacos de lixo, lixeira e bolsa de suprimentos. O setor encontra-se no subsolo, com acesso do colaborador ao posto de trabalho por elevadores e escadas rolantes e deslocamento pelas áreas operacionais do aeroporto.

Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura em bipedestação para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, deambulação por toda extensão do aeroporto para o atendimento do voo, rotação e flexão do tronco e esforço físico para limpeza e deslocamento da escada da aeronave.

Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para inspeções e limpezas e percepção auditiva para atendimento telefônico e detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais em áreas operacionais.

Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

  • Auxiliar Administrativo (Operações)

As atividades consistem na gestão do faturamento e conciliação documental diária dos voos realizados, encaminhamento para departamento financeiro, elaboração de relatórios, lançamento de dados no sistema, arquivo, leitura e envio de e-mail. Dentre os equipamentos e mobiliários utilizados destacam-se cadeira, mesa, arquivos, microcomputador, impressora com 1,28m de altura do piso e telefone. O setor encontra-se no piso térreo, com deslocamento do colaborador pelas áreas administrativas e operacionais do aeroporto por meio de elevadores e escadas rolantes.

Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e inferiores, postura variável para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, eventualmente existe a necessidade de esforço físico e deambulação entre áreas administrativas e operacionais do aeroporto.

Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para elaboração de relatórios, leitura e elaboração de e-mails, faturamento, lançamento de dados no sistema, e percepção auditiva para atendimento telefônico e aos colaboradores, visitantes e clientes.

Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio concluído;
  • Boa comunicação interpessoal;
  • Proatividade;
  • Vontade de aprender;
  • Vontade de trabalhar em equipe;
  • Disciplina e organização;
  • Disponibilidade de horário e para trabalhar em turnos rotativos presenciais;

Informações adicionais

Todos os envios de CV devem vir obrigatoriamente acompanhados do "LAUDO CARACTERIZADOR DE DEFICIÊNCIA ". De acordo com o Decreto 3.298/1999 e com a Instrução Normativa SIT/ MTE n.º 98 de 15/08/2012, observados os dispositivos da Convenção sobre os Direitos das Pessoas com deficiência, Lei 12764/12, Lei13146/2015.

Desenvolvimento: incentivo à educação, treinamentos técnicos e comportamentais

A NOSSA VOCAÇÃO É CUIDAR DE PESSOAS!

Somos referência em excelência no cuidado. É através do propósito de cuidar de pessoas, promovendo saúde e qualidade de vida, que imprimimos a nossa essência em todas as nossas ações, desenvolvendo uma gestão e assistência humanizadas.

Integrantes da maior rede de assistência médica do Brasil, o Sistema Unimed, somos a maior Cooperativa médica de Alagoas, contando mais de mil cooperados.

A nossa liderança no mercado de saúde suplementar reforça nosso compromisso e evidencia a confiabilidade dos mais de 130 mil beneficiários Unimed Maceió, comprovando o nosso Jeito de Cuidar.

Para isso, contamos com um time de UnIncríveis formado por mais de mil colaboradores e uma rede de mais de 10 Serviços Próprios , incluindo Hospital, Laboratórios, Centro de Diagnósticos, SOS e clínicas especializadas no cuidado integrado, multidisciplinar e contínuo.

O bem-estar sempre em primeiro plano

93% dos colaboradores afirmam que somos um bom lugar para trabalhar, segundo a Pesquisa de Clima Organizacional, aplicada em 2023.

É por meio do autoconhecimento que gerenciamos nossas emoções e valorizamos nossos clientes internos e externos, com objetivo de encantá-los através de uma relação saudável e do trabalho em equipe, cooperando para que todos cresçam cada vez mais.

Valorizamos e apoiamos a diversidade, considerando para nossas vagas pessoas com deficiência, pluralidades de raça, cor, religião e gênero.

Quem faz parte do nosso time conta com Benefícios Unincríveis para colaboradores, que oferece descontos em parceiros que oferecem serviços que promovem saúde e bem-estar, além de outras categorias como educação e alimentação.

Além disso, oferecemos ações exclusivas voltadas ao autocuidado, através do Programa Equilíbrio, como Ginástica Laboral, Wellhub (antigo Gympass), Unimed Ativa e apoio psicológico.

Tudo isso além do plano de saúde, odontológico, auxílio-creche, vale-transporte reduzido, vale-alimentação, seguro de vida e o queridinho day-off no dia do aniversário (para colaboradores administrativos).

Em desenvolvimento contínuo

Investimos no desenvolvimento de nossa equipe por meio de treinamentos técnicos e comportamentais, que são parte integrante de nossa rotina. Acreditamos que o aprendizado constante é essencial para o crescimento profissional e pessoal de cada Médico Cooperado e colaborador. Através destes, não apenas reforçamos a Essência Unimed, mas também garantimos que cada um possa aplicar efetivamente o conhecimento adquirido em seu trabalho diário, contribuindo assim para o sucesso individual e coletivo da equipe.
